title: Classic White Bread
desc: Simple everyday loaf with a soft crumb and crisp top.
steps: Mix flour, water and yeast. Rest 15 min.
Add salt and butter. Knead until smooth and elastic.
Bulk ferment 60–90 min, until doubled.
Shape, place in loaf tin, proof 45–60 min.
Bake until deep golden and fully set.

title: Ciabatta
desc: Overnight ciabatta with open crumb and crisp crust.
steps: Mix flour, yeast and most of the water. Rest 20–30 min.
Mix in salt with remaining water; add oil if using.
Do 3–4 stretch-and-folds, 30 min apart.
Cover and refrigerate 12–18 hr.
Warm 60–90 min, tip onto a floured surface and divide gently.
Proof 30–45 min. Bake 10 min with steam at 250°C, then 12–18 min at 220°C.

title: Focaccia
desc: Airy interior, olive-oil crust, easy tray bake.
steps: Mix flour, water and yeast. Rest 20 min.
Add salt and half the oil. Fold until cohesive.
Bulk ferment 2 hr with 2–3 folds.
Transfer to oiled tray. Proof 60–90 min.
Dimple, add remaining oil and salt. Bake until deeply golden.

title: French Baguette
desc: Lean dough, crisp shell, creamy open crumb.
steps: Mix flour, water and yeast. Rest 20 min.
Add salt and knead briefly.
Bulk ferment 2–3 hr, or refrigerate overnight after 60 min.
Divide, pre-shape, rest 20 min, then shape baguettes.
Proof 40–50 min, score, and bake with steam.

title: Soft Sandwich Bread
desc: Tender enriched loaf for toast and sandwiches.
steps: Mix flour, milk and yeast. Rest 10 min.
Add salt, sugar and butter. Knead until smooth.
Bulk ferment 60–90 min.
Shape tightly and proof in loaf tin 45–60 min.
Bake until golden; cool before slicing.

title: Rustic Overnight Bread
desc: Mix at night, bake the next day. Crisp crust and open crumb.
steps: Mix everything until no dry flour remains.
Cover and ferment 12–18 hr at cool room temperature.
Shape gently and rest 45–60 min.
Score and bake with steam or in a preheated Dutch oven.

title: Soft Burger Buns
desc: Soft, rich buns that stay light but hold a burger well.
steps: Mix flour, milk and yeast. Rest 10 min.
Add salt, sugar, egg and butter. Knead smooth.
Bulk ferment 60–75 min.
Divide into 8, shape tight balls and proof 45–60 min.
Brush with egg or milk and bake until golden.

title: Dinner Rolls
desc: Soft pull-apart rolls for dinner or sandwiches.
steps: Mix flour, milk and yeast. Rest 10 min.
Add salt, sugar and butter. Knead until elastic.
Bulk ferment 60–75 min.
Divide into 12, shape and place close together in a tray.
Proof 45–60 min and bake until golden.

title: Simple Sourdough
desc: Straightforward sourdough with a flexible hydration range.
steps: Mix flours and most of the water. Rest 30 min.
Add starter and salt; mix thoroughly.
Bulk ferment 4–6 hr with folds during the first 2 hr.
Shape and cold proof 8–12 hr.
Score and bake in a hot Dutch oven or with steam.

title: Cinnabon-Style Cinnamon Rolls
desc: Soft cinnamon rolls with cream-cheese frosting.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, milk, eggs and yolks. Knead 5 min.
Work in butter and salt; knead 8–10 min until elastic. Rise 1–1½ hr.
Divide dough in 2 and roll each to about 40 × 30 cm.
Spread butter; add brown sugar, cinnamon and salt. Roll up and cut 10–12 pieces per log.
Proof 40–60 min. Bake at 180°C conventional / 170°C fan for 22–28 min.
Beat frosting ingredients smooth and spread over warm rolls.

title: Drømmekage / Sjónvarpskaka
desc: Soft vanilla cake with warm brown-sugar coconut topping.
steps: Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla until pale and fluffy.
Fold in flour and baking powder. Mix in melted butter and milk.
Pour into lined 30 × 40 cm tray. Bake 30–35 min.
Melt topping butter, brown sugar and milk; stir in coconut.
Spread over cake and bake about 10 min more until golden.

title: Bounty Cake
desc: Gotterí Bounty kaka — coconut cake with chocolate cream.
steps: Beat egg whites with 140 g icing sugar until thick and fluffy.
Fold in 140 g coconut. Bake at 150°C for about 40 min. Cool.
Melt butter and chocolate together over a water bath. Set aside briefly.
Beat egg yolks with 60 g icing sugar until pale and light.
Fold in the chocolate mixture. Spread over the cooled cake and sprinkle with coconut.

title: Carrot Cake
desc: Moist spiced carrot cake with simple cream-cheese frosting.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and cinnamon.
Whisk eggs and oil; fold into dry ingredients, then add carrot.
Bake until set and a skewer comes out clean. Cool fully.
Beat cream cheese, butter and icing sugar. Spread over cake.

title: Simple Chocolate Cake
desc: Deep chocolate flavour, soft crumb, straightforward method.
steps: Mix flour, cocoa, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk in eggs, milk and oil. Stir in hot coffee last.
Pour into tin and bake until just set.
Cool before slicing or frosting.

title: Pavlova with Lemon Curd
desc: Crisp meringue shell, soft centre and sharp lemon curd.
steps: Whip egg whites to soft peaks. Add sugar gradually until glossy and dissolved.
Fold in cornstarch, acid and vanilla. Shape on baking paper.
Heat oven to 150°C, put pavlova in, immediately reduce to 120°C and bake 75–90 min. Cool in switched-off oven.
For curd, whisk yolks, sugar, zest and juice over low heat until thick.
Remove from heat and whisk in butter. Chill, then spoon onto pavlova.

title: Apple Crumb Cake
desc: Moist apple cake with cinnamon crumb topping.
steps: Heat oven to 175°C. Grease and line a 23 cm pan.
Mix dry cake ingredients. Whisk eggs, oil, buttermilk and vanilla separately.
Combine wet and dry just until mixed; fold in apples.
Mix crumb flour, brown sugar and cinnamon; stir in melted butter. Scatter over batter.
Bake 35–40 min until a skewer comes out clean.

title: Chocolate Orange Cheesecake
desc: Baked chocolate cheesecake with orange and ganache topping.
steps: Crush biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into 18 cm tin. Chill.
Whisk sugar, orange zest and eggs briefly. Mix in mascarpone, cream cheese and sour cream.
Mix in melted chocolate and cocoa. Pour over base.
Bake in a water bath at 160°C for about 80 min; centre should wobble slightly. Cool, then chill overnight.
Heat cream and honey; pour over topping chocolate. Stir smooth, add butter and pour over cheesecake.

title: Date Cake with Caramel Sauce
desc: Soft date cake served with warm caramel sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 180°C. Cover dates with water, boil, remove from heat 3–4 min and mash lightly. Stir in baking soda.
Beat butter and sugar fluffy; add eggs one at a time.
Mix in flour, cinnamon, salt, baking powder and vanilla, then fold in date mixture.
Bake 35–40 min.
For sauce, boil butter, cream and brown sugar together until slightly thickened but still pourable.

title: Espumilla de Frutilla
desc: Light strawberry foam dessert.
steps: Put egg white and about 2 tbsp sugar in a heatproof bowl over a bain-marie.
Whisk about 10 min, heating mixture to at least 72°C.
Add remaining sugar and strawberry purée.
Beat 10–15 min until thick, fluffy and pale pink.

title: Lemon Meringue Cheesecake
desc: Baked lemon cheesecake with lemon curd and meringue.
steps: Bake biscuit crust 7–8 min at 180°C. Reduce oven to 140°C.
Mix cream cheese, sugar, zest and vanilla. Add sour cream, lemon juice and eggs gently; mix in cornstarch.
Pour over crust and bake about 1 hr until edges are set and centre jiggles slightly. Cool gradually and chill at least 5 hr.
Cook lemon curd ingredients gently until thick; chill and spread over cheesecake.
Whisk meringue ingredients over simmering water until sugar dissolves, then beat to stiff glossy peaks. Spread over curd and torch lightly.

title: Caesar Salad Dressing
desc: Classic creamy Caesar dressing with anchovy and Parmesan.
steps: Whisk yolk, anchovy, garlic, Dijon, lemon juice and Worcestershire together.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking until emulsified.
Stir in Parmesan. Season with pepper and salt if needed.
